fontProvenance: Installed macOS and Microsoft fonts; Apple PDF has embedded subsets of Helvetica Neue regular/bold/italic, Arial regular/bold italic, Times New Roman italic and Apple Color Emoji. This environment and fixture are qualified.
reproduction: Generate the RichExample model in IWorkKeynoteRichTextWritingTests. Open a working copy in Keynote 15.4, export PDF with best quality, all slides and optional content/password off, then export PPTX without a password. In the second slide change plain to reset, save, close and reopen. Independently decode the frozen creation with verify-keynote-creation.py and extract the selected native ranges/PPTX with extract-keynote-rich-runs.py.
boundaries: Native application export is separate from direct OfficeIMO PDF rendering.
The native PPTX expresses plain Arial ranges through +mn-lt; both recorded theme font schemes use ArialMT, the Arial PostScript name.
PDF text extraction and rendered appearance have separate font and Unicode boundaries.
This does not qualify other application versions, fonts, scripts, images, tables, transitions, builds or loaded-source save-back.
